message:
Now let me look at the fuzzer harness and understand how the input is fed. Let me check the fuzzer file and the build script.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace -name "*fuzz*" -o -name "*fuzzer*" 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo "---" && cat /workspace/build.sh && echo "---" && cat /workspace/submit.sh</parameter>
